title: week2
introduction: In our class, we discussed some ideas about Daisy Bell.We discussed and learned about Harold Edgerton, a famous photographer and engineer. He is best known for his high-speed photography, which means taking photos of things that move super fast.We learned that he invented a special electronic flash to help him 'stop time' in his photos and capture things that our human eyes cannot see.We looked at two of his most famous works. The first one is called Milk Drop Coronet, where a drop of milk hits a table and creates a shape just like a crown. The other one is a bullet passing through an apple, where you can clearly see the bullet and the apple breaking apart in a second.We really enjoyed his work because it mixes science and art. It shows us a secret world that happens too fast for us to notice.
